name: feature_scan
description: Sweep a whole image or blob with bulk_extractor and return what it found per feature: addresses, URLs, domains, card numbers, EXIF, telephone numbers and more, with counts, the top values and the offset each came from. Works with no file system at all.

path.description: An image, a partition, or any blob

out_dir.description: Where the feature files land, under work/. Must not already exist.

top.description: How many distinct values to return per feature (default 15)
